content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: baseline (main lifts: 0 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 5 of 6 planned. Sets: 71.
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 80 kg x 8 (last week -), no earlier data, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last week -), no earlier data, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 100 kg x 6 (last week -), no earlier data, 4 sets this week
- Overhead Press: 45 kg x 8 (last week -), no earlier data, 8 sets this week
- Lat Pulldown: 55 kg x 10 (last week -), no earlier data, 6 sets this week
No new records.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 18, Back 23, Front delts 15, Side delts 10, Rear delts 10, Quads 7, Hamstrings 6, Glutes 11, Biceps 13, Triceps 15, Calves 1.
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Build muscle".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- missed_sessions (priority 40). Advice: Name the missed sessions and suggest a realistic way to fit the work in or plan around those days. Never scold; if the note explains it, acknowledge that.
    - data {"done":5,"planned":6,"missed":1,"routines":"Leg Day","dates":"2026-10-02","lowGroups":"Quads, Hamstrings"}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.

name: submit_report_text
